projects.title: Event Hub
projects.description: A full-stack event booking marketplace where users discover and book events, merchants sell services and decorations, and admins manage the whole platform.
features: Event discovery, booking, and QR-code tickets.
Razorpay payments with coupons, wallets, and merchant payouts.
Real-time chat and notifications with Socket.io.
Google and GitHub sign-in alongside email login.
Merchant services, decorations, and photo galleries.
Reviews, saved events, complaints, and venue maps.
projects.overview: Event Hub brings event organisers, service merchants, and attendees onto one platform. Users browse and book events, pay online, and receive QR-code tickets. Merchants list services such as decorations and manage their payouts, while admins oversee bookings, banners, categories, complaints, and platform settings.
projects.problemStatement: Planning and attending events usually means juggling separate tools for discovery, ticketing, payments, vendor coordination, and support. Event Hub puts these workflows in one place for attendees, merchants, and administrators.
projects.architecture: A React + TypeScript single-page app (Vite, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui) talks to an Express REST API backed by MongoDB through Mongoose, with 20+ data models covering events, bookings, tickets, wallets, and payouts. Socket.io powers live chat and notifications, Razorpay handles payments, Cloudinary stores gallery images, and Nodemailer sends booking emails.
securityFeatures: Google and GitHub OAuth sign-in through Passport.
